sourceTitle: Cookies And Milk- Walnut Oatmeal Cookies
sourceText:
Cookies And Milk- Walnut Oatmeal Cookies
By: Mateja ^_^
Published: Saturday, November 13, 2010 - 3:29pm

Ingredients




Ingredients:
1 cup butter, softened
1 1/2 cups light brown sugar
1 large egg
1 teaspoon old fashioned oatmeal
1 1/2 cups all-purpose flour
3 cups walnuts, finely chopped
1 teaspoon vanilla
2 tablespoons molasses
1 teaspoon baking soda
1/4 teaspoon ground nutmeg
1/4 teaspoon ground ginger

Preparation

1 Directions: 2 Preheat oven to 350*F. 3 In a smaller bowl mix together flour, oatmeal, baking soda, and spices. In a large bowl mix soft butter and light brown sugar until well combined. Add egg, molasses, and vanilla, and beat until light and fluffy. Add flour mix and combine well until all the flour mix is completely moistened. Stir in finely chopped walnuts with a wooden spoon. 4 Drop the cookie dough with an ice-cream scoop onto un-greased cookie sheet about 2 inches apart. Flatten cookies with a bottom of a glass to 1/2 inch thickens. 5 Bake 10 - 12 minutes or until golden brown. 6 Cool slightly and enjoy with a cup of cold milk. 7 Store the remaining cookies, if there are any left, in an air tight container after they are completely cooled. 8 Tip: I always cover my cookie sheet with aluminum foil, so I'm more quickly done with the clean up after baking and I have more time to spend with my family exchanging our events of the day, playing some games and sweetening up with cookies and milk.

About


Chocolate chip oatmeal cookies are still our No.1, but variety of ingredients brings joy to your taste pallet. And who knows, maybe even a new favorite cookie in someones recipe book.
